extendedData.name: OracleText
extendedData.value:
The best time for your community's first Magic game is now. Dive into Foundations, and experience quintessential Magic: The Gathering by playing with and collecting cards selected to give every player the advantage. Whether a past, present, or future Magic player, Foundations invite you to share your spark!
Your customers' Magic journey begins in this box—where the way to learn is to play. They'll get the essentials for their first games of Magic: The Gathering, including two different hands-on guided deck experiences, reference booklet, playmats, and bonus packs for easy jump-in play with a friend. All they need to do is start!
Contents:
• 3 Foundations Beginning Boxes
